description: This file defines the 'StreamIdentity' class, which encapsulates the unique identity of a stream within Orleans streaming framework. The class contains properties for a GUID and a namespace, methods for equality comparison and hash code generation, and includes serialization attributes.

classes.name: StreamIdentity
classes.description: A class representing a unique identifier for a stream, containing GUID and namespace, with equality and hash code implementations.

methods.name: StreamIdentity
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new instance with a GUID and namespace.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to determine equality based on Guid and Namespace.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.GetHashCode to generate a combined hash from Guid and Namespace.
